disclaimer: REBUS Lab tests computational mechanisms INSPIRED by the REBUS model (relaxed beliefs under psychedelics) in a simulated circuit replayed offline on recorded data. It does not simulate a drug, subjective experience, hallucination or consciousness; 'intensity' is a dimensionless multiplier of registered parameter changes.

experiment.created_utc_note: see git log; no wall-clock value is part of the result
experiment.title: AlphaMorph // REBUS Experiment 001

limitations: One recorded stream and one candidate circuit (c0); results do not generalise beyond them.
c0 enters very rarely: internal dynamics and decision divergence are the primary outcomes; performance is descriptive and usually INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Seeds only randomise the RANDOM comparator (5 seeds): the REBUS-vs-RANDOM comparison is coarse. The REBUS condition itself is deterministic.
Shadow-weights (counterfactual learning) are a research construct that never feeds back into the decision actually taken; their effect is shown only through 'shadow decisions'.
Counterfactual outcomes come from fixed-notional paper positions opened at abstentions (selection-biased); they are not trade records.
Decisions of different conditions are matched on (token, decision obs, apply obs, sensory flag); decisions that exist in one condition only are reported as unmatched, not imputed.
Tokens are the bootstrap cluster; decisions of one token are not independent. Observations of the same stream are not independent of the market regime.
Fixed hand-chosen registered maxima and intensity levels; no claim that any level is 'optimal'.

performance.reason: needs >= 15 realized closes on >= 8 tokens in both arms; descriptive numbers are in metrics.per_condition.*.outcomes

tests.multiple_comparison_note: Holm correction over the registered primary family ['H1', 'H2', 'H3b', 'H4', 'H5', 'H6'] (m = number of tests that could be formed). LOW/MEDIUM levels, ablations beyond H1-H3b, dose-response, per-window metrics and per-condition CIs are descriptive/secondary and NOT corrected: do not read their intervals as confirmatory.

primary.unit: bits (M2 minus CONTROL, matched PEAK decisions)

primary.note: 5 seeds: the RANDOM mean is a coarse comparator; the CI is over tokens, not over seeds

nodes.label: Thalamus
nodes.role: Attention gate: top-k salience routing of evidence channels

nodes.label: Prefrontal
nodes.role: Planner: consumes the three specialist votes as structured messages

nodes.label: Hippocampus
nodes.role: Episodic memory: nearest-neighbour recall of past closed outcomes

nodes.label: Amygdala
nodes.role: Threat: provenance, whale/sniper share, tax, snipe window, curve nearly full

nodes.label: Basal ganglia (Go)
nodes.role: Go drive of the go/no-go competition

nodes.label: Basal ganglia (No-Go)
nodes.role: No-Go drive with mutual inhibition and feedback

nodes.label: ACC
nodes.role: Conflict/error monitor: specialist spread and prediction error, can force abstain

nodes.label: Cerebellum
nodes.role: Execution calibration: predicts fee/slippage friction from paper fills

nodes.label: Dopamine
nodes.role: Reward prediction error: realised paper return minus predicted
